verdict.rationale: Decagon's own docs say its voice agents are built for "natural, multilingual conversations," which is a thin, single-channel signal that it can serve customers in multiple languages. Nothing shows answers in other languages being generated from an English-only knowledge base. missing for 10: evidence of answering in other languages from an English-only knowledge base, multilingual support on chat and email, a list of supported languages or language detection, independent or hands-on corroboration.
